description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Severity: High (calibrated). Trunk is RED on this right now.

The requirement ancora.gate.change_findings says: "A changed file under lib_paths that lies in no subject footprint shall produce change/uncovered_file." The code does not do that. ChangeAnalysis.uncovered_findings/2 (lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex:24) filters on PolicyFiles.classify(path) == :lib, and classify hardcodes priv/, lib/, skills/, and mix.exs (lib/ancora/policy_files.ex:44-56). It never consults lib_paths. This is a code defect against a must, not a spec defect — the requirement text is already correct and must not be edited to match the code.

Two consequences, both live:
1. A project configured with lib_paths: ["src"] silently gets ZERO uncovered-file findings, so the check is inert for any repo that does not use the hardcoded layout.
2. Ancora own trunk is red because of it. main reports 31 change/uncovered_file warnings on vendored priv/spec_review_assets/*.js, priv/spec_init/*.eex, and mix.exs — files no subject tagged test should ever reach. These were previously papered over by Spec-Ack trailers that the squash merge destroyed (see ancora-sfu).

Fix: thread the already-resolved lib_paths into the check. preflight.project is a %Ancora.ProjectInfo{} carrying lib_paths, and preflight is already in scope at the ChangeAnalysis.findings call site (lib/ancora/gate.ex:172). Pass lib_paths through and filter on "path is under one of lib_paths" instead of classify == :lib. For this repo lib_paths resolves to ["lib"], so the 31 findings disappear and the trunk goes green without any acknowledgment.

Do NOT weaken the requirement, do not add a config demotion, and do not add a Spec-Ack trailer. The point is to make the code match a contract that is already right.

Verification: a test proving a file under a CONFIGURED lib_paths (for example lib_paths: ["src"] with src/thing.ex) produces the finding, and a test proving a changed file outside lib_paths (priv/ asset) does not. Both tagged to ancora.gate.change_findings. Existing scenario ancora.gate.scenario.* for uncovered_file must still pass. Full suite green on both CI matrix legs; mix spec.check --base origin/main ends result=pass.

Status note (2026-09-03): IMPLEMENTED and awaiting cold verification. The 'Trunk is RED right now' framing above is stale; main CI has been green since the 13:17 workflow_dispatch run once the default branch moved to main. The fix is still required for the lib_paths: ["src"] case and to make the code match the must.
Stage worktree: /Users/mz/src/ancora-p47-libpaths
Stage branch: ancora-p47/uncovered-lib-paths
Base sha: 5d9cb40 (equals the epic branch ancora-xla/post-ship-hardening tip at admission)
Laborer run: codex p47-impl-1 (see the IMPLEMENTED comment)
Re-checked on 2026-09-03 in the stage worktree: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean, mix format --check-formatted clean, mix test 3 properties 333 tests 0 failures, mix spec.check --base main result=pass. Orchestrator: resume from IMPLEMENTED; run rigor-check diff then spawn the verifier rooted at the stage worktree. Do not respawn an implementer.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: Ancora.GateTest "changed source under configured lib_paths is reported" and "changed files outside lib_paths are not reported" (test/ancora/gate_test.exs), both tagged to ancora.gate.change_findings; existing ancora.gate scenario tests for uncovered_file
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) lib_paths: ["src"] with a changed src/thing.ex produces change/uncovered_file; (2) a changed priv/ asset or mix.exs outside lib_paths produces nothing; (3) the requirement text is unchanged; (4) no trailer, no config demotion
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or explicitly named test files, plus mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission plus tagged and --stale selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path.
  - Fixture hygiene: one TmpGitRepo per test, no shared temp dirs, async only where the fixture allows.
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface. Drift, growth, and shrink clear only through substantive requirement or scenario edits in the same diff, never through a Spec-Ack trailer.
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test.
- proves: a changed file under configured lib_paths is flagged and one outside is not.

Allowed touches (this ticket may modify):
- lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex, lib/ancora/gate.ex, lib/ancora/policy_files.ex
- test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/ancora/policy_files_test.exs, test/support/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (must NOT be weakened; only scenario additions if any)

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/review/**
- lib/ancora/derive/**
- lib/ancora/trailer.ex
- .spec/config.yml

Out of Scope (intent):
- no requirement edit that moves the contract toward the old code
- no acknowledgment of any kind

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.check --base the epic base sha recorded at admission ends result=pass

Mechanical scope: exactly four files across the stack, no violations — lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex, lib/ancora/gate.ex, test/ancora/gate_test.exs, test/support/ancora_case.exs. lib/ancora/policy_files.ex is BYTE-IDENTICAL between 5d9cb40 and HEAD, so PolicyFiles.classify/1 was not touched. ChangeAnalysis.findings/5 keeps its public arity and @spec; lib_paths rides in on the footprint map under a :__lib_paths__ sentinel that uncovered_findings/2 pops before folding values. All three implementer claims hold.

Assertion integrity: base 374 test / 7 property / 109 refute / 910 assert; head 376 / 7 / 110 / 913. Deltas are exactly the two new p47 tests. The test diff contains no removed line matching assert, refute, test, or property. Nothing weakened, nothing deleted.

Requirement untouched: git diff 5d9cb40..HEAD -- .spec/ is EMPTY. ancora.gate.change_findings still reads "A changed file under lib_paths that lies in no subject's footprint shall produce change/uncovered_file", priority must. No Spec-Ack trailer (commit body is the single subject line). .spec/config.yml untouched.

Directory boundary — exercised through the real Gate.check, not read: the comparison is String.starts_with?(path, String.trim_trailing(lib_path, "/") <> "/"). With lib_paths ["lib"] and a changed set of library.ex, lib/a.ex, libs/a.ex, mix.exs, skills/s.md, priv/p.txt, the ONLY finding was lib/a.ex. With lib_paths ["src"] and src/a.ex, src_old/a.ex, lib/a.ex, library.ex, the only finding was src/a.ex. A trailing-slash config "src/" behaves identically. ProjectInfo.validate_lib_paths/1 guarantees non-empty all-binary, so the helper never sees nil.

New tests fail pre-fix — proven independently, not accepted on claim: the verifier cloned the worktree to scratch, dropped its .git so no git command could reach the real index, and overlaid the 5d9cb40 versions of change_analysis.ex and gate.ex while keeping HEAD's gate_test.exs. Result: 18 tests, 2 failures, both of them the new tests. "changed source under configured lib_paths is reported" failed at gate_test.exs:106 with an empty findings list because classify("src/thing.ex") returns :unknown; "changed files outside lib_paths are not reported" failed at :125 because classify("priv/assets/app.js") returns :lib and produced a finding. Honest caveat recorded by the verifier: the library.ex half of the second test does NOT fail pre-fix (classify("library.ex") is already :unknown), so that assertion is a forward-looking guard against a naive starts_with? implementation rather than a reproduction of the defect.

mix.exs dropping out: FOLLOWS FROM THE REQUIREMENT, not a regression. The statement is scoped to files "under lib_paths", and lib_paths resolves to elixirc-style source directories which never include a root file; the same narrowing drops priv/ and skills/. The 17 findings that disappeared are mix.exs plus 16 priv/ files — .eex scaffold templates and vendored minified Prism JS/CSS. No tagged Elixir test can ever reach a minified vendor asset, so flagging them was noise, and this removes false positives rather than coverage.
Worth the team knowing: PolicyFiles.classify/1 now feeds NO gate finding at all, only Ancora.Next advice at lib/ancora/next.ex:39. If the project wants mix.exs gated, that is a spec edit, not a code edit.

Re-runs: spec.check --base 5d9cb40 -> result=pass (changed_files=4, findings=7, error=0 warning=0). spec.check --base origin/beadwork -> result=fail warnings=14 (changed_files=380, findings=21). The 31->14 drop is confirmed and all 14 survivors are change/uncovered_file on paths under lib/ (json.ex, modal_class.ex, review/file_diff.ex, review/spec_diff.ex, the five schema/*.ex, task_args.ex, temp_name.ex, and the three mix/tasks/spec.*.ex). That residual belongs to the CI-base ticket (ancora-xla.5), not to this stack. mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix format --check-formatted both exit 0.

Verdict: PASS. Gaps: none.

Notes (advisory): the :__lib_paths__ sentinel is the weakest part of this change — it makes findings/5's second argument two things at once, and the ["lib"] default is load-bearing for the direct-call test at gate_test.exs:148 which passes %{}, so that default would silently paper over a caller who forgets the key. A sixth parameter or a small struct would say what it means. Design preference, not a defect, and this ticket explicitly asked for the public arity to stay put. Separately, under_lib_path?/2 at change_analysis.ex:30 duplicates the boundary rule already living as source_path?/2 at lib/ancora/derive/module_locator.ex:155, with slight differences between them.

title: change/uncovered_file must honor lib_paths instead of hardcoded prefixes
